description: Amendments to the Strategic Development Projects Act, No.14 of 2008
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - At the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑07‑07, Policy approval of the Cabinet has been granted to amend the Strategic Development Projects Act, No.14 of 2008. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
